summary:
12 research items cleared the filter out of 60 raw tweets over the 4-day window (48 dropped as empty-banks noise from MikeZaccardi's high-frequency chart/price stream; no neilksethi/neilksethinew items this cycle; no duplicates found).

Goldman dominates with a fiscal/macro cluster: rising debt-to-GDP (100%→123% by 2035), interest expense nearing 1990s peaks, low US tax take vs G7, plus CPI/PCE tracking (pre- and post-print) and steady central-bank gold buying.

Hartnett/BofA flags cash-heavy positioning — private-client cash at a record low, transportation stocks testing the 200-day MA as an autumn-stagflation tell, and fading bond/equity diversification even as $1.5T in AI spend shows no productivity payoff yet.

Single items: Apollo's Slok on the AI-deployment disclosure gap, JPMAM's Mythos red-team study on harmful AI actions, and a Yardeni-sourced chart via LanceRoberts on accelerating forward-EPS upgrades.

Counts: Goldman 6, BofA 3, Apollo/Slok 1, JPM 1, Yardeni 1.
